dataset.description:
This description covers the research data and analytical materials used in the doctoral
thesis on the integration of digital technologies and automation in port logistics
management and its impact on efficiency and sustainability. It includes literature review
materials, comparative and case-study data, sustainability- and CO₂-related analytical
materials, assessment tables, and other materials relevant to the empirical and
methodological parts of the study.
dataset.title: Research data and analytical materials

dmp.description:
This doctoral research aims to analyse the integration of digital technologies and
automation in port logistics management and to develop an integrated analytical
framework for assessing their impact on operational efficiency and sustainability. The
study addresses key issues of port digitalisation, interoperability, environmental
performance, CO₂ monitoring, organisational readiness, and workforce adaptation in
maritime logistics.
